item.title: Dataflows Part 1 - Choice Column with Single Value
item.description: Learn how to work with single-value Choice columns in Dataverse and configure them with Dataflows.
item.author: fukszon.kostya@gmail.com (Konstantin Fukszon)

item.title: Dataflows Part 3 - LookUp Column with Single Value
item.description: In Part 3 of the Dataflows series, we focus on working with Dataverse Lookup Columns (Single Values) and how to prepare, map, and validate them in Power Platform dataflows.
item.author: fukszon.kostya@gmail.com (Konstantin Fukszon)

item.title: Dataflows Part 2 - Choice Column with Multiple Values
item.description: Learn how to handle multi-select Choice columns from SharePoint and map them into Dataverse using Power Query dataflows. This post walks through creating a custom lookup table, expanding and merging multiple values, and grouping them back into a format that Dataverse can store. Includes step-by-step guidance and Power Query code snippets.
item.author: fukszon.kostya@gmail.com (Konstantin Fukszon)
